data.title: Binghatti House
data.about:
Binghatti House is a beacon of modern architecture and neighbourhood pride, with a variety of studio, one- and two-bedroom apartment options. The architectural masterpiece's balconies are intricately intertwined, giving the impression of movement and breaking away from the norm. 

These unique balconies not only provide people a place to relax outside, but they also help the environment by providing shade and cutting down on cooling costs. The building is a reflection of Binghatti Developers' trademark modern aesthetic, which they skillfully fused with classical touches reminiscent of Middle Eastern art and architecture. 

Each apartment has its own private patio or balcony without sacrificing any of the building's seclusion. Binghatti House is more than simply a home because of its ideal location; it's also a sound investment.

location_tile.title: Prime Location in JVC, Dubai
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Binghatti House stands as an epitome of strategic luxury, nestled within the esteemed confines of Jumeirah Village Circle. Its pivotal location offers residents a doorway to Dubai's prime destinations, ensuring that the city's vibrant pulse is never far away. Whether it's the allure of seaside views or the promise of a shopping spree, Binghatti House places you right where the action is.

AREAS NEARBY:

  • 07 Mins from Mall of Emirates
  • 10 Mins from Dubai Marina
  • 12 Mins from Downtown Dubai
